name: autoexec_script_version
label: Automation Custom Tool Version Table
description: The automation custom tool version table is used for tracking automation-related statuses, enabling status filtering, time dimension statistics, and association queries.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: script_id
fields.description: Script ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Draft: under review, rejected: rejected, passed: approved, submitted: pending approval. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_status
indexes.description: Standard index covering the status field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uniq_scriptid_version
indexes.description: Unique index covering the script_id, version fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
